name: io.github.Syfer-web/krexel-mcp
description: Ship and edit static sites from any MCP-compatible AI. The AI is the brain; Krexel is the hands.

environment_variables.description: Base URL of the Krexel orchestrator API.
environment_variables.name: KREXEL_API_URL

environment_variables.description: Account API key minted at krexel.com/signup. Forwarded as Authorization: Bearer *** to every API call. Required.
environment_variables.name: KREXEL_API_KEY

environment_variables.description: 32-byte hex master key used to encrypt domain env vars (AES-256-GCM). Required only for set_env.
environment_variables.name: KREXEL_MASTER_KEY
